# Sliding gate: a candy block 0.5 m (along x) by 1.1 m (along the lane's width) by 0.45 m tall,
# a white top. Origin at the centre of its foot. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Gate --base-color 1.0000 0.4235 0.4784 --no-slot
material new Top --base-color 0.9804 1.0000 0.9882 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Gate --size 1 --location 0 0 0.225
scale 0.5 1.1 0.45
apply --scale
material assign Gate
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Top
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export gate.glb
